name: GIGABYTE B850 GAMING X WIFI6E AM5 Motherboard
shortDescription: GIGABYTE B850 GAMING X WIFI6E AM5 Motherboard (Socket AM5 / AMD B850 Chipset / 12+2+2 Phase Twin Digital VRM / Dual Channel DDR5 up to 8200MT/s OC / PCIe 5.0 x16 Slot / 1x PCIe 5.0 M.2 + 2x PCIe 4.0 M.2 / Realtek 2.5GbE
descriptionHtml:
GIGABYTE B850 GAMING X WIFI6E AM5 Motherboard (Socket AM5 / AMD B850 Chipset / 12+2+2 Phase Twin Digital VRM / Dual Channel DDR5 up to 8200MT/s OC / PCIe 5.0 x16 Slot / 1x PCIe 5.0 M.2 + 2x PCIe 4.0 M.2 / Realtek 2.5GbE LAN / Wi-Fi 6E + Bluetooth 5.3 / EZ-Latch Plus / ATX Form Factor)

Empower your next-generation gaming rig with the GIGABYTE B850 GAMING X WIFI6E AM5 Motherboard, available at Turbo Computer Egypt. Built to harness the full potential of AMD Ryzen 9000, 8000, and 7000 Series processors, this ATX motherboard features a robust 12+2+2 Twin Digital VRM power design, advanced DDR5 memory overclocking capabilities up to 8200+ MT/s, ultra-fast PCIe 5.0 graphics and M.2 storage slots, Realtek 2.5GbE LAN, integrated Wi-Fi 6E wireless connectivity, and DIY-friendly EZ-Latch mechanisms for effortless PC building.

Technical Specifications

FeatureSpecification Details
Brand & ModelGIGABYTE B850 GAMING X WIFI6E (rev. 1.x)
CPU Socket & ChipsetAMD Socket AM5 / AMD B850 Chipset (Supports Ryzen 9000 / 8000 / 7000 Series)
Power Delivery (VRM)12+2+2 Twin Digital VRM Design (6+6 Parallel Phases 60A DrMOS) with VRM Thermal Armor Advanced
Memory Support4 x DDR5 DIMM Slots (Up to 256GB Dual Channel / EXPO & XMP Support / OC up to 8200+ MT/s)
PCIe Expansion Slots1 x PCIe 5.0 x16 UD Slot (PCIe 4.0 mode on Phoenix CPUs) + 2 x PCIe 3.0 x1 Slots
Storage Interfaces1 x M.2 PCIe 5.0 x4 Slot + 2 x M.2 PCIe 4.0 x4 Slots + 4 x SATA 6Gb/s Ports (RAID 0/1/5/10)
Networking & WirelessRealtek 2.5GbE Ethernet LAN + Realtek Wi-Fi 6E RTL8852CE (2.4/5/6 GHz) + Bluetooth 5.3
Audio HardwareRealtek Audio CODEC High Definition Audio (7.1-Channel Support)
Display Outputs1 x HDMI 2.1 (4096x2160@60Hz) + 1 x DisplayPort (3840x2160@144Hz)
DIY & Thermal FeaturesEZ-Latch Plus, EZ-Latch Click, M.2 Thermal Guard Ext, WIFI EZ-Plug, Q-Flash Plus & Smart Fan 6
